claims.claim: C-IDS gives a directly applicable regret guarantee for this project

claims.claim: B RL proposal has improved C7
claims.evidence_locator: No policy implementation/training/environment run in current research phase
claims.conclusion: All proposed benefits are hypotheses. C7 existing4800exposed full-clear evidence remains the only cited local performance.

claims.claim: The new RL wrapper has a paper-only finite fallback virtual bound below 53000 seconds from position box [-4000,4000]^2
claims.evidence_locator: PROPOSAL.md sections 6.1–6.3; public problem disk radius 1800, source range 1000–1500, angle rounding
claims.conclusion: Conditional geometric construction: 49 stations, 304 clear points per source, <=5844 measure/clear plus EXIT, bound 52195.68773235279 s. RL preemption 300000+2300+53000<360000. New wrapper contract, not a proof that original C7 stays in the box; no implementation or environment execution. Common wrapper also caps accepted learning primitives at 10000 and hands over after 32 learning scheduling decisions without certified progress; same guard for Q/PPO.

claims.claim: The fallback also unconditionally completes within the real 1200-second limit
claims.conclusion: Only conditional on deterministic request/compute bounds and adequate remaining 25-minute window. No such bounds measured or established. P99 reserve is engineering evidence, not deterministic guarantee.

claims.claim: B Q labels are in the same per-source normalized units as the E[T/N] objective
claims.conclusion: T0=1000; cost reward -dt/(1000N); failure terminal once -100; history-Q marginalizes hidden N; N only post-episode trainer labels. Approximate compressed Q/off-policy learning is not proved exact or optimal; finite failure penalty is not lexicographic completeness.
